feed.title: The Best Running Podcasts 2026
feed.subtitle: An independent, hand-curated directory of the best running podcasts—road, track, trail, ultra, skyrunning, and training science. Each entry is reviewed for quality and usefulness for runners, coaches, and fans. Filter by training focus and language, discover Spotify and Apple Podcasts links, and find shows worth your long run.

entry.title: The Morning Shakeout
entry.summary: The host, Mario Fraioli, is the coach to some of the best runners on the planet. He has a newsletter with the same name as the podcast. He interviews top athletes, coaches, and personalities in the sport of running.

entry.title: Wolfie’s World of Running
entry.summary: Brian aka 'Wolfrunner' is the host of this unfiltered trail & ultra running podcast, representing the 95 — the husbands, wives, fathers, mothers raising trail sons and daughters. "We identify with running, our identity doesn't start/stop with running. Keep Ultra Running Weird."

entry.title: Ultraaktuellt
entry.summary: Swedish ultrarunning news podcast with host Daniel Westergren and sidekick Johnny Hällneby.

entry.title: Run Long After 60
entry.summary: A podcast about durability, curiosity, and continuing to do hard things as the years stack up, hosted by Mark Vega. Conversations with runners, endurance athletes, coaches, creatives, and professionals who are still showing up, often recorded in motion.

entry.title: Bad Boy Running
entry.summary: British duo Jody Raynsford and David Hellard are hosts to this gem of a podcast - one of the longest running (running) podcasts out there. Unfiltered british humour at its best/worst. Sometimes they have guests on, some time its just them chatting.

entry.title: CITIUS MAG Podcast
entry.summary: Hosted by CITIUS MAG founder Chris Chavez. The show was named one of "The Best Running Podcasts" by Runner's World.

entry.title: The Freetrail Podcast
entry.summary: American trail and ultrarunning podcast that features interviews with elite athletes, coaches, race directors, and other influential figures in the sport, alongside discussions of major races, training, and industry trends. Hosted by Dylan Bowman, aka "the voice of the sport", it focuses on the people, stories, and ideas shaping the global trail running community.

entry.title: The Boulder Boys
entry.summary: Boulder based pro ultra trail runners Seth Ruhling, Adam Merry, Matt Daniels, Drew Holmen and Moisés Jimenez takes you behind the scenes of the trail running scene and gives you hot unfiltered takes on what's happening in the trail running space.

entry.title: Black Hat Ultra
entry.summary: Polish trail and ultrarunning media platform centered around a long-form podcast featuring in-depth conversations with elite athletes, coaches, race directors, and endurance adventurers.

entry.title: The PR Project Podcast
entry.summary: Long-form podcast/YouTube show exploring the culture, performance, and people shaping modern running. Conversations with athletes, founders, coaches, and creatives across road, trail, and endurance running.
